question:
**Select the most appropriate option to complete the given sentence.**

She raised a __________ when she saw her luggage missing.
solution:
The correct answer is **hue and cry.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank is** 'Hue and cry'.**
 
• The idiom **"hue and cry"** means **a loud and public outcry or protest against something.**
